integrity: General theorem supported by a direct image/kernel flag proof and complete independent small-field matrix enumerations; finite examples alone do not prove the general statement.
scientific_limitations: Counts labelled square-zero elements for finite fields and fixed sandwich rank only; no arbitrary nilpotency indices or orbit classification. The rank-one geometric components are reduced loci. Publication priority remains subject to further literature review.
title: Square-zero census in finite rectangular sandwich matrix algebras
